description: Notification that a stored document changed, so that open editors and embedded blocks can refresh (or, on delete, degrade) without polling.

members.name: DocumentId
members.description: Identifier of the document that changed.

members.name: Kind
members.description: Kind of the document that changed.

members.name: ModifiedAt
members.description: The document's new last-modified timestamp (after the change).

members.name: Origin
members.description: Optional identifier of who/what produced the change (user, session, or "mcp"), so a subscriber can ignore echoes of its own writes.
